mapper.select: SELECT id, report_task_id AS task_id, report_type AS type, report_title AS title, report_period_start AS period_start, report_period_end AS period_end, report_status AS status, generated_at, data_latest_time, freshness_status, freshness_snapshot AS freshness_json, raw_record_count, unique_problem_count, generation_source, report_content AS content_json, facts_snapshot AS facts_json, generated_summary, validation_status, validation_errors, prompt_version_snapshot AS prompt_version, prompt_sha256_snapshot AS prompt_sha256, skill_version_snapshot AS skill_version, model_name_snapshot AS model_name, model_config_snapshot AS model_config, provider_request_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, estimated_cost_usd, degraded, scope_snapshot FROM t_ai_report WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, report_type AS type, report_title AS title, scope_snapshot FROM t_ai_report WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_report( public_id, report_type, report_title, report_period_start, report_period_end, data_latest_time, raw_record_count, unique_problem_count, report_content, facts_snapshot, generated_summary, validation_status, validation_errors, prompt_version_snapshot, skill_version_snapshot, model_name_snapshot, degraded, scope_snapshot, report_status, generated_at, generation_source, created_by, published_at ) VALUES( UUID_TO_BIN(#{row.publicId}), #{row.type}, #{row.title}, #{row.periodStart}, #{row.periodEnd}, #{row.dataLatestTime}, #{row.rawRecordCount}, #{row.uniqueProblemCount}, CAST(#{row.contentJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{row.factsJson} AS JSON), #{row.summary}, #{row.validationStatus}, CAST(#{row.validationErrors} AS JSON), #{row.promptVersion}, #{row.skillVersion}, #{row.modelName}, #{row.degraded}, CAST(#{row.scopeSnapshot} AS JSON), #{row.status}, NOW(3), #{row.source}, #{row.actor}, CASE WHEN #{row.status} = 'PUBLISHED' THEN NOW(3) ELSE NULL END )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_report SET prompt_sha256_snapshot = #{row.promptSha256}, model_config_snapshot = CAST(#{row.modelConfig} AS JSON), provider_request_id = #{row.providerRequestId}, input_tokens = #{row.inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{row.outputTokens}, latency_ms = #{row.latencyMs}, estimated_cost_usd = #{row.estimatedCostUsd}, freshness_status = #{row.freshnessStatus}, freshness_snapshot = CAST(#{row.freshnessJson} AS JSON) WHERE id = #{row.id}
